text:
maya (PM): quick sync: need a compact request/response telemetry contract for launch. goals: small payloads, explicit token fields, deterministic trace id.

sam (API): +1. prefer flat keys instead of nested to save bytes.

linda (Eng): propose tele_ prefix: tele_prompt_tokens, tele_completion_tokens, tele_cost_micros. server can compute tele_total_tokens if omitted.

rahul (ML): use prompt/completion naming to match model teams. include emb (array) + emb_dim for embeddings, rank_score + rank_position for rerank.

maya (PM): trace ids: require trace_id as 16-hex (8 bytes) at top level, optional parent_id and client_request_id. document collision tradeoffs.

noah (DevEx): tool calls: flat suffix pattern tele_tool_0_name, tele_tool_0_status, tele_tool_0_out_bytes limited to 5 entries. SDKs map to nicer structures.

sam (API): tele_route optional for routing hints (hosted, dedicated-v2). tele_cost_unit optional (e.g. "micros"). server wins if disagreement on computed values.

linda (Eng): gateway will enrich telemetry (token splits, cost) to keep clients light. also validate trace_id length and normalize UUIDs.

rahul (ML): add CI checks: token accounting must match prompt+completion within 1 token; monitor rank distributions for regressions.

maya (PM): launch gates: spec published, SDK mappings for py/ts/go, docs + examples, gateway enrichment in canary, telemetry pipeline updated, 48h canary with no token regressions.

sam (API): security note: client_request_id may accidentally contain PII; docs must advise opaque ids and retention policies.

noah (DevEx): example payloads for docs: {"id":"r_abc","trace_id":"3f2a1b00e5c4d7f1","tele_prompt_tokens":12,"tele_completion_tokens":34,"tele_cost_micros":1200} and chat+tool example with tele_tool_0_* keys.

linda (Eng): timeline: week1 spec + SDK mapping, week2 gateway enrichment + logs, week3 canary, week4 rollout. ops must sign off on log schema window.

ops-bot: deploy-gateway v1.12 scheduled 2026-04-02T02:00Z (canary available).

maya (PM): action items: sam -> draft compact spec by EOD, noah -> SDK checklist, linda -> schedule canary infra, rahul -> regression tests. reconvene Thu. :rocket:
